headline: I find the bugs, so your users don't have to.
intro: Hi, I'm Indra Kuswara, a QA Engineer based in Bekasi, Indonesia, with 7+ years of experience across SaaS, supply chain, and digital media. I inspect down to the last half-second. How we treat people is remembered longer than any label attached to us.
name: Indra Kuswara

philosophy.note: The principle I work by: firm on bugs, kind to people.
philosophy.quote: If you are kind to others, they will never ask what your religion is.

projects.body: 78 test cases, 233 assertions. A Playwright + TypeScript framework built on the Page Object Model, running across 3 browsers (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit), with HTML reports delivered automatically on every CI run via GitHub Actions.

projects.body: 28 functional API tests with Zod response-schema validation, plus 5 performance scenarios (smoke, load, spike, soak, stress). Load tests are guarded so they never hit the public demo API.

projects.body: Post-deploy smoke validation for a live Next.js site on Vercel. Every successful production deploy triggers the Playwright + TypeScript suite automatically. It runs full CRUD against production with uniquely-marked test data, published briefly, then deleted in the same run, and posts a per-test report with a screenshot for every test to a hidden owner page. Verified run: 26 tests, 22 passed, 0 failed, 20 screenshots uploaded.
projects.title: Deploy Validation Automation
